This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.

>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>Beg pardon?
>

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>Beg pardon?
>

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.

 A quantity of water

>Taken.
>You are carrying:

>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden

nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.

>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.

Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>Beg pardon?
>

 A quantity of water

>Taken.

A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch

nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.

antiquity.
>Taken.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud

This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.

axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
There is a set of skeleton keys here.
The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
There is a set of skeleton keys here.
The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.
>Beg pardon?
>

>The lamp is now on.

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
There is a set of skeleton keys here.
The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
There is a set of skeleton keys here.
The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>Beg pardon?
>

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
There is a set of skeleton keys here.
The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

front door.

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have

the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
There is a set of skeleton keys here.
The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase
leading up.
A cyclops, who looks prepared to eat horses (much less mere
adventurers), blocks the staircase.  From his state of health, and
the bloodstains on the walls, you gather that he is not very
friendly, though he likes people.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>The cyclops says 'Mmm Mmm.  I love hot peppers!  But oh, could I use
a drink.  Perhaps I could drink the blood of that thing'.  From the
gleam in his eye, it could be surmised that you are 'that thing'.
>You are in a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase
leading up.
The cyclops, having eaten the hot peppers, appears to be gasping.
His enflamed tongue protrudes from his man-sized mouth.
The cyclops seems somewhat agitated.
>The cyclops appears to be getting more agitated.
The cyclops is rather heavy and doesn't take kindly to being grabbed.
>Beg pardon?

Welcome to Dungeon.
This version created December 12.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded
front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,
and all the windows are barred.
>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there
is a small window which is slightly ajar.
>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have
been used recently for the preparation of food.  A passage leads to
the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward.  To the
east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden
door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be
nailed shut, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud
of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
A skeleton, probably the remains of a luckless adventurer, lies here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
There is a set of skeleton keys here.
The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase
leading up.
A cyclops, who looks prepared to eat horses (much less mere
adventurers), blocks the staircase.  From his state of health, and
the bloodstains on the walls, you gather that he is not very
friendly, though he likes people.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>The cyclops says 'Mmm Mmm.  I love hot peppers!  But oh, could I use
a drink.  Perhaps I could drink the blood of that thing'.  From the
gleam in his eye, it could be surmised that you are 'that thing'.
>You are in a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase
leading up.
The cyclops, having eaten the hot peppers, appears to be gasping.
His enflamed tongue protrudes from his man-sized mouth.
The cyclops seems somewhat agitated.
>The cyclops appears to be getting more agitated.
The cyclops is rather heavy and doesn't take kindly to being grabbed.
>Opened.
>The cyclops looks tired and quickly falls fast asleep (what did you
put in that drink, anyway?).
>You can't be serious.
>Beg pardon?
>

 A quantity of water

A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch

There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.

>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.

out of the room.

>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.

>You are in a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase

The cyclops seems somewhat agitated.

>Opened.
>The cyclops looks tired and quickly falls fast asleep (what did you

>You can't be serious.
>You are in a room with an exit on the west side, and a staircase

>The cyclops yawns and stares at the thing that woke him up.

You are in an open field west of a big white house, with a boarded

>You are facing the north side of a white house.  There is no door here,

>You are behind the white house.  In one corner of the house there

>With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
>You are in the kitchen of the white house.  A table seems to have

The glass bottle contains:
 A quantity of water
>Opening the sandwich bag reveals a clove of garlic, and a .lunch.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>You are carrying:
A glass bottle with a quantity of water
A .lunch
>You are in the living room.  There is a door to the east, a wooden

There is a trophy case here.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
There is an issue of US NEWS & DUNGEON REPORT dated 12/12/77 here.
On hooks above the mantelpiece hangs an elvish sword of great
antiquity.
>Taken.
>Taken.
>With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room.
With the rug moved, the dusty cover of a closed trap-door appears.
>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending
into darkness.
>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading
east, and a crawlway to the south.  On the west is the bottom of a
steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions. 
Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the
walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.

>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.

axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.

of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the
carcass has disappeared.

>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

 A quantity of water

>Taken.
>Taken.

>The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending

>The lamp is now on.
>You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading

The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
>You are in a small room with passages off in all directions.

A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages
out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
>Your sword pinks the troll on the wrist, but it's not serious.
The troll swings his axe, but it misses.
>The troll's weapon is knocked to the floor, leaving him unarmed.
The troll, now worried about this encounter, recovers his bloody
axe.
>It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud

carcass has disappeared.

>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.
>You are in a maze of twisty little passages, all alike.

>Opened.

>You can't be serious.
